title: ranunculus subangustifidus
intro: Ranunculus subangustifidus, commonly known as the narrow-leaved buttercup, is a species of flowering plant in the Ranunculaceae family. The plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Ranunculus subangustifidus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-edematous and anti-histaminic effects.
